item.title: Sandworm-Linked UAC-0145 Uses Fake Job Interviews to Push VPN That Can Run Commands
item.summary: The Computer Emergency Response Team of Ukraine (CERT-UA) has disclosed details of a new social engineering campaign orchestrated by Russian nation-state threat actors targeting IT workers in the country by masquerading as recruiters to trick them into installing malware.
